messages.subject: How to propose a project?
parts:
Hi. I'm new to the group.  We are interested in proposing a GSoC project for our NIMBLE package (R-nimble.org).  Is it possible to do this under R's GSoC umbrella?  I see the organization applications start in 3 days.  Many thanks for any information or guidance.
Perry

messages.author: 334c7505e0b5cf65
messages.subject: Re: How to propose a project?
parts:
El vie, 06-02-2015 a las 09:37 -0800, pdeva...@berkeley.edu escribió:
> Hi. I'm new to the group. We are interested in proposing a GSoC
> project for our NIMBLE package (R-nimble.org). Is it possible to do
> this under R's GSoC umbrella? I see the organization applications
> start in 3 days. Many thanks for any information or guidance.

In principle, yes. But you will need to come up with a proposal when the
time arrives. Right now, organisations need to submit an application to
be accepted in the programme and we will not know until the 2nd of
March whether R is accepted or not. Likely that it will be, I think! :)

Best,

Virgilio
